target: For any continuous-time diffusion SDE dx = f(x,t)dt + g(t)dw_t evolving p_0(x) into p_t(x), the deterministic Probability Flow ODE dx = [f(x,t) - 0.5 g(t)^2 grad_x log p_t(x)]dt shares the exact same marginal densities p_t(x), and a Consistency Model f_theta(x_t, t) = c_skip(t) x_t + c_out(t) F_theta(x_t, t) maps every point along an ODE trajectory directly to its clean origin x_epsilon in a single step.

nodes.name: Consistency Model f_theta(x_t, t) = x_epsilon collapses the ODE trajectory to 1 step
nodes.why_needed: This is the depth-0 target claim: learning the ODE flow map directly eliminates multi-step numerical integration.
nodes.visual_seed: Gold arcs jumping from multiple points (x_t, t) along the same streamline directly to a single glowing bead x_epsilon on the clean manifold t = epsilon.

nodes.name: Skip parametrization c_skip(t) x + c_out(t) F_theta(x,t) anchors f_theta(x, epsilon) = x
nodes.why_needed: Self-consistency alone could collapse to a constant unless the boundary condition at t = epsilon is satisfied identically.
nodes.visual_seed: Two smooth weight curves c_skip(t) and c_out(t) crossing as t approaches epsilon, pinning c_skip(epsilon)=1 and c_out(epsilon)=0.

nodes.name: Deterministic Probability Flow ODE dx/dt = f(x,t) - 0.5 g(t)^2 grad_x log p_t(x)
nodes.why_needed: A consistency map requires a well-defined deterministic trajectory connecting noise x_T to clean data x_epsilon.
nodes.visual_seed: Tangled coral reverse-SDE paths smoothing into laminar golden-blue streamlines that slice cleanly through the 3D density surface p_t(x).

nodes.name: Reverse-time SDE driven by the score and reverse Brownian motion
nodes.why_needed: Shows how diffusion is inverted stochastically before stripping out the noise term to reveal the deterministic ODE.
nodes.visual_seed: Noisy particles at t = T riding the score arrows backward in time while still jittering randomly.

nodes.name: The score grad_x log p_t(x) points uphill toward the data modes
nodes.why_needed: Both the reverse SDE and the Probability Flow ODE depend on the gradient of log marginal density as their compass.
nodes.visual_seed: Sky-blue vector arrows across the (x, t) floor pointing away from the x=0 saddle and toward the two ridge crests at x = -2 and x = +2.

nodes.name: Forward SDE dx = f(x,t)dt + g(t)dw_t smooths p_0(x) into Gaussian marginals p_t(x)
nodes.why_needed: Establishes the 3D space-time density surface p_t(x) over (x, t) that the rest of the film navigates.
nodes.visual_seed: A 3D translucent olive surface where a sharp two-peaked curve at t = 0 spreads and flattens into a broad single-humped bell at t = T.

sources: Song, Sohl-Dickstein, Kingma, Kumar, Ermon, & Poole (2021). Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations. ICLR 2021.
Song, Dhariwal, Chen, & Sutskever (2023). Consistency Models. ICML 2023 (OpenAI).
Anderson (1982). Reverse-time diffusion equation models. Stochastic Processes and their Applications.
